name: Katsu Kaishuu
source:
"I don't know what lies ahead. If the Shogunate's attacks didn't reach here that would be good but, this will probably come all the way to the capitol."
Even while being a retainer of the Shogunate he is focused on opening Japan to the western world and is fascinated by the forces that want to overthrow the government.
He admires [url=/c43495]Sakamoto Ryouma[/url] and taught him how to sail ships.
